content:
The official MLB iPhone app is rolling out a useful update for fans looking to stay on top of more games. Both the CarPlay app and Live Activity experience have seen several improvements.

The new version of the MLB app lets users start a Live Activity for any game on the schedule.

Previously, this feature was limited to the user's favorite team. To use it, open the Gameday page for the matchup and tap the newly added "Follow" button at the top; the game will then appear on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.

MLB has also improved the CarPlay experience. MLB has long been one of the standout apps on the CarPlay platform.

Fans can browse in-progress and upcoming games, select matchups, and choose their favorite team's radio broadcast. CarPlay will display the score and key game information during the broadcast, while the app's "Hide Scores" setting remains in effect for fans who want to avoid spoilers.

Earlier this summer, MLB had already expanded the live score widgets on iPhone and iPad. CarPlay on iOS 26 and later can also display iPhone widgets.

Later this month, Apple Vision Pro users will be able to enjoy the first Friday Night Baseball game through immersive video on Apple TV.

The MLB app is available for free download on the App Store.
